image_description: A high-angle, close-up photograph of a metallic green tiger beetle resting on a coarse, grey gravel surface. The beetle exhibits a vibrant emerald green exoskeleton with iridescent highlights. Its head is distinct from the thorax, featuring large compound eyes and long, slender antennae. Six legs are visible, splayed out for stability on the uneven ground. The elytra (wing covers) appear smooth but lack the distinctive pale markings often seen in some species, presenting a mostly uniform metallic green.
